summary: Complete encryption integrity test results for GhostNet. 42/42 tests passed across 4 layers: GhostChat E2E (HKDF+AES-GCM+HMAC), server-side encryption (AES-256-GCM+HMAC-SHA256), crypto identity key protection (PBKDF2+AES-GCM), and full lifecycle integration. Verifies confidentiality, authenticity, integrity, recipient isolation, replay protection, non-determinism, key protection, and absence of plaintext leaks.
